api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Applications: List Planning Applications

api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting position in the result set. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum number of applications to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

functionality: Retrieves a list of Planning applications available in the Oracle EPM Cloud environment.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Dimensions: List Dimensions

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.planType: string: Plan type to filter dimensions. Example: 'Plan1', 'Plan2', 'Workforce'.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

functionality: Retrieves all dimensions defined in a Planning application, such as Account, Entity, Period, Scenario, and Version.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Members: List Dimension Members

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.dimension: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the dimension. Example: 'Account', 'Entity', 'Period'.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum members to return. Default is 50.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return. Example: 'memberName,alias,parentName,level'.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter expression. Example: q=memberName:contains:Total to filter members containing 'Total'.

functionality: Retrieves members of a specific dimension in a Planning application. Useful for listing accounts, entities, or periods.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Members: Get a Member

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.memberName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the member to retrieve.

functionality: Retrieves properties of a specific dimension member including alias, parent, level, UDA, and custom attributes.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Members: Add a Member

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.memberName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the new member to add.
api_arguments.parentName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the parent member under which this member is added.
api_arguments.alias: string: Alias label for the member.
api_arguments.dataStorage: string: Data storage type. Valid values: Store, NeverShare, SharedMember, DynamicCalc, DynamicCalcAndStore, LabelOnly.
api_arguments.aggregation: string: Aggregation operator. Valid values: +, -, *, /, %, ~, None.
api_arguments.twoPassCalc: boolean: If true, enables two-pass calculation for the member.
api_arguments.smartList: string: Name of the smart list to associate with the member.
api_arguments.dataType: string: Data type. Valid values: Currency, NonCurrency, Percentage, SmartList, Date, Text.

functionality: Adds a new member to a dimension in a Planning application.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Data: Export Data to File

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.planType: [REQUIRED] string: Plan type from which to export data. Example: 'Plan1'.
api_arguments.entity: string: Entity member or range. Example: 'Total Entity' or 'E001'.
api_arguments.fileName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the output file to store exported data in the Planning inbox.
api_arguments.columnMembers: string: Comma-separated list of dimension members to use as columns.
api_arguments.rowMembers: string: Comma-separated list of dimension members to use as rows.

functionality: Exports Planning data for a specified slice (scenario, version, entity, period) to a file in the EPM Cloud inbox.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Data: Import Data from File

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.fileName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the file in the Planning inbox to import.
api_arguments.planType: [REQUIRED] string: Target plan type for the import.
api_arguments.clearData: boolean: If true, clears existing data in the target slice before importing. Default is false.
api_arguments.abortOnError: boolean: If true, aborts the import if any data errors are encountered. Default is true.

functionality: Imports data from a file in the EPM Cloud inbox into a Planning application. The file must follow the Planning data load format.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Business Rules: List Business Rules

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.planType: string: Filter rules by plan type.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum rules to return. Default is 50.

functionality: Retrieves all business rules (calculation scripts) defined in a Planning application.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Business Rules: Launch a Business Rule

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.ruleName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the business rule to launch.
api_arguments.planType: [REQUIRED] string: Plan type context for the rule execution.
api_arguments.runtimePrompts: array: Array of runtime prompt objects required by the rule. Each object contains promptName and promptValue. Example: [{"promptName": "Scenario", "promptValue": "Budget"}, {"promptName": "Version", "promptValue": "Working"}]

functionality: Launches a Planning business rule (Essbase calculation script) with optional runtime prompt values.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Task Lists: List Task Lists

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum task lists to return.

functionality: Retrieves task lists used to guide users through the Planning process, such as budget submission workflows.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Approval Units: List Approval Units

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum approval units to return.

functionality: Retrieves approval units (entity-scenario-version combinations) and their current approval status in the Planning workflow.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Approval Units: Change Approval Status

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.action: [REQUIRED] string: Approval action to perform. Valid values: Promote, Approve, Reject, SignOff, Exclude.
api_arguments.comments: string: Comments accompanying the approval action.
api_arguments.notifyUsers: boolean: If true, sends notifications to affected users. Default is true.

functionality: Promotes, approves, or rejects a Planning approval unit in the budget approval workflow.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Jobs: List EPM Jobs

api_arguments.jobType: string: Filter by job type. Valid values: Rules, Ruleset, Plan, ImportData, ExportData, ClearData, ImportMetadata, ExportMetadata, Refresh.
api_arguments.status: string: Filter by job status. Valid values: Processing, Completed, Failed, Cancelled.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum jobs to return. Default is 25.

functionality: Retrieves the job history and status of EPM Cloud Planning jobs such as rule launches and data imports.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Scenarios: List Scenarios

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return. Example: 'memberName,alias,startYear,startPeriod,endYear,endPeriod'.

functionality: Retrieves all scenario members (e.g., Actual, Budget, Forecast) defined in the Planning application along with their time range properties.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Substitution Variables: List Substitution Variables

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.planType: string: Filter variables by plan type.

functionality: Retrieves substitution variables and their current values. Variables like CurMonth and CurYear are used in forms and rules to represent dynamic time periods.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Substitution Variables: Update a Substitution Variable

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.variableName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the substitution variable to update. Example: 'CurMonth'.
api_arguments.planType: string: Plan type scope for the variable. Omit for global scope.
api_arguments.value: [REQUIRED] string: New value for the variable. Example: 'Jun'.

functionality: Updates the value of a substitution variable, typically used to advance the current planning period at month-end.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Data Forms: List Forms

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.
api_arguments.planType: string: Filter forms by plan type.

functionality: Retrieves data entry forms defined in a Planning application, used by budget holders to enter or review data.

api_name: REST API for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning - Users: List Application Users

api_arguments.application: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the Planning application.

functionality: Retrieves users who have access to a specific Planning application along with their assigned roles.
